patthana15.15:1.1: hetuṃ micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na micchattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.15:2.1: hetuṃ sammattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu sammattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.15:3.1: na hetuṃ aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
